page_title: BHA 1-1 EVE | Brighton v Everton 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+9' Excellent touch by Jack Harrison (Everton)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
90+8' A player from Brighton takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+5' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Pascal Gross sends a long raking pass onto the head of Lewis Dunk (Brighton), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the top right corner. 1:1.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+5' Simon Adingra (Brighton) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Brighton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+2' Amadou Onana (Everton) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
90+1' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Beto (Everton) for his blatant foul.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
90' Julio Enciso (Brighton) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
89' It's time for a substitution. Ashley Young (Everton) comes on in place of Abdoulaye Doucoure.
89' Dwight McNeil (Everton) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tony Harrington blows his whistle for an infringement.
89' Brighton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

88' Ansu Fati (Brighton) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Jordan Pickford makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner. The ball is out of play. Brighton will have a chance to score from a corner.
87' Beto (Everton) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.

86' What a wasted opportunity by Julio Enciso (Brighton)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Jordan Pickford makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
84' Amadou Onana (Everton) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
82' The injury to Amadou Onana (Everton) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
81' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) is shown a red card by the referee for chasing his opponent and bringing him down with a very nasty tackle!
79' Simon Adingra (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
77' Simon Adingra (Brighton) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
75' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Evan Ferguson will be replaced by Adam Lallana (Brighton).
73' 0 - 1 Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and fires a superb strike into the top right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
73' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Pascal Gross (Brighton) duly receives a yellow card.
72' Tony Harrington blows his whistle after Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
72' Substitution. Julio Enciso (Brighton) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Facundo Buonanotte walks off.

72' Close! James Garner (Everton) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
70' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tony Harrington had an easy-decision to make.
69' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Jordan Pickford easily deals with the threat.
68' The referee signals a substitution. Beto (Everton) is brought on as a substitute for Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
66' James Garner (Everton) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
63' Amadou Onana (Everton) is unable to get a good contact on the ball from the corner and heads it well wide of the left post from close range.
63' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Everton.
62' Dwight McNeil (Everton) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Joel Veltman (Brighton) replaces Tariq Lamptey.
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ansu Fati (Brighton) comes onto the pitch so that Danny Welbeck can be given a rest.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Igor departs the field of play to be replaced by Pervis Estupinan (Brighton).
60' What a great touch by Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot towards the roof of the net, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
58' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' Pascal Gross (Brighton) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Now Brighton have a corner.
54' Referee Tony Harrington has finally had enough of Roberto De Zerbi and brandishes a yellow card at him!
54' One of the players from Everton times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Simon Adingra (Brighton) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
49' Sean Dyche is forced to make a change. Idrissa Gueye is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Amadou Onana (Everton).
49' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
46' The whistle blows and Tony Harrington starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
43' A player from Everton commits a rough challenge. Tony Harrington blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Brighton.
42' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
40' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
40' The ball goes behind for a corner. Brighton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

40' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brighton are going to take it.
37' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
35' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by James Tarkowski (Everton) was quite harsh and Tony Harrington didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
33' Everton fail to score from a corner as Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) leaps to collect the ball.
32' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Everton will take a corner kick.
31' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes.

27' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
27' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brighton.
27' Simon Adingra (Brighton) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Brighton.

25' Simon Adingra (Brighton) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
24' The corner is swung in but Everton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
23' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
20' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
20' The referee signals a corner kick to Brighton.
19' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
19' Simon Adingra (Brighton) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
18' Brighton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

18' Simon Adingra (Brighton) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brighton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
17' James Garner (Everton) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul. Brighton are awarded the free kick.
15' Tony Harrington interrupts the game. One of the players from Brighton won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
12' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
12' James Garner (Everton) jumps into a tackle and Tony Harrington signals a foul.
10' Pascal Gross (Brighton) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
9' Simon Adingra (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Brighton force a corner. They send men into the box.
9' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

8' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes out of play. Brighton are awarded a corner kick.
5' The ball is cleared after Danny Welbeck (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner which is cleared.
3' Simon Adingra (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Good work from Brighton as they win a corner.
3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
2' Simon Adingra (Brighton) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Corner kick. Brighton will have an opportunity.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Brighton will take the kick-off.
Tony Harrington is introduced as the referee for today's match.
